summary: Acquittal appeal in murder case; evidence reliability on oral testimonies of PWs 5, 8, 9; FIR limitations for corroboration/contradiction under Sections 157, 145 Evidence Act; dying declaration by relative treated cautiously; appellate perversity standard per Jai Karan v. State, Govindaraju v. State; impugned acquittal based on inconsistent testimony; prosecution failed to prove guilt beyond reasonable doubt.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court acquittal upheld; conviction set aside.
